title: TesseraQL document envelope v1
description: The envelope every TesseraQL document carries, for the kinds whose own trees no schema describes yet: workflow/*.yml, scope/*.yml, and attachments/*.yml. It validates the discriminators and leaves the rest open, which is honest about what is checked - these documents used to be associated with the route schema, which offered route keys they do not have and knew nothing of the keys they do.
$comment: A placeholder, not a destination: each of these kinds deserves its own schema, tracked in docs/unified-sources.md.

kind.description: workflow (an approval lifecycle), scope (a row-visibility predicate), or attachment (an uploaded-file surface). Each has its own tree, documented in approval-workflow.md, data-scoping.md and attachments.md.
